title: Account Constellation Prioritization
content:
Purpose: a compact, sortable account sheet for the QBR/renewal sprint — helps CS leads triage outreach based on ICP-fit, deployment mode, region, and near-term commercial signal. Use this as a working sheet during planning and sprint standups.

COLUMNS (one row per account):
- Account: canonical customer name
- ARR: current annual recurring revenue (USD)
- ICP_Fit: 1-5 (5 = perfect ICP alignment: AI-native product + heavy inference usage + growth motion)
- Deployment: hosted | dedicated | private (on-prem / VPC)
- Region: NA | EMEA | APAC | Global
- Renewal_window: YYYY-MM (start of 90-day window)
- Engagement_score: 1-10 (composite: usage, contacts, escalations)
- Usage_trend: up | flat | down (last 90d tokens / embeddings vs prior 90d)
- Churn_signals: short flags (e.g., exec change, budget freeze, slow adoption)
- Priority_score: computed (see rubric below)
- Recommended_cadence: monthly | 6-week | quarterly | inbound-only
- Playbook_snippet: 2–3 step recommended playbook for outreach / mitigation
- Owner: CS lead assigned
- Next_action: clear next step and date (e.g., schedule exec align 2026-03-05)
- Notes: context, links to tickets, contacts

EXAMPLE ROWS (populate during sprint):
1) Nebula Health Inc. | 1,200,000 | 5 | private | NA | 2026-05 | 9 | up | none | 93 | monthly | (1) Exec health check with CTO; (2) capacity review for burst; (3) propose dedicated discount + engineering touchpoint | Priya K. | schedule 30m CTO sync by 2026-03-10 | heavy ML infra, plans to expand to Europe; link: JIRA-ENG-204

2) Atlas Retail Group | 420,000 | 3 | hosted | EMEA | 2026-04 | 6 | flat | procurement slowdown | 56 | 6-week | (1) Usage demo showing cache savings; (2) propose batching recommendation + cost estimate; (3) open billing conversation | Diego R. | send cost-savings one-pager by 2026-03-04 | procurement lead changed Jan; pilot still active

3) Meridian Fintech | 85,000 | 4 | dedicated | NA | 2026-06 | 7 | down | budget review flagged | 48 | monthly | (1) Book roadmap sync with security; (2) show KMS integration plan; (3) offer flexible commit terms | Liam O. | prep security brief by 2026-03-12 | regulated workloads, proof-of-concept expanding

4) OpenMuse Labs | 28,000 | 2 | hosted | APAC | 2026-03 | 4 | down | low usage, feature mismatch | 19 | inbound-only | (1) gather feedback + collect top-10 prompts; (2) propose model profile that reduces latency | Maya C. | request feedback survey 2026-02-28 | small account, potential churn if adoption not increased

5) Vector Logistics | 320,000 | 4 | dedicated | Global | 2026-07 | 8 | up | none | 70 | monthly | (1) plan scale-runbook; (2) SRE review of failover across regions; (3) canary release plan for quantized models | Priya K. | arrange SRE call 2026-03-15 | expansion to EU market on roadmap

PRIORITY SCORING (compact rubric to compute Priority_score column):
- Normalize ARR to 0-100 scale: score_arr = min(100, floor(20 * log10(ARR + 1)))  (quick heuristic)
- ICP multiplier: icp_mult = ICP_Fit / 5
- Engagement multiplier: eng_mult = Engagement_score / 10
- Deployment adjustment: private +10, dedicated +5, hosted +0
- Region adjustment: NA +0, EMEA +0, APAC -5, Global +5
- Priority_score = round(score_arr * icp_mult * eng_mult + deployment_adj + region_adj)

Interpretation: >75 = top-tier outreach (exec + dedicated engineering play). 45-75 = mid-tier (commercial + technical touch). <45 = lightweight / automated nurture.

TRIAGE RULES (quick):
- If Renewal_window within 90 days AND Priority_score >= 60 -> assign "Immediate QBR" (owner to propose exec calendar within 7 days).
- If Usage_trend == down AND Engagement_score <= 5 -> open Adoption Playbook (targeted feature enablement + TAM).
- If Churn_signals include "budget" or "procurement" -> route to AM + Finance partner; prepare discount scenario deck.
- If Deployment == private and ICP_Fit >=4 and ARR >= 250k -> consider Dedicated CS + Engineering add-on (higher SLA).

PLAYBOOK SNIPPETS (use-short names for copy-paste into outreach):
- Exec-Align (30m): agenda = current ROI + runway + capacity; deliverable = executive one-pager and comms plan.
- Cost-Saver Demo (45m): show batching + cache numbers; deliverable = 3-tier cost model for 6/12/24 months.
- Security+Compliance Brief (60m): detailed KMS/HSM mapping, SOC/ISO links; deliverable = signed readiness checklist.
- Adoption Sprints (4w): weekly enablement, top-20 prompts, telemetry goals; deliverable = adoption scoreboard after 4 weeks.

MEETING TEMPLATES / TALKING POINTS (clipboard-ready):
- "We're seeing X token growth correlating to Y product usage; here's what we suggest to keep latency steady while lowering unit cost..."
- "If you anticipate regulatory expansion to EU, we recommend a private-region deployment plan and runbook we can co-author."

NOTES FOR THE SPRINT (operational):
- Owner must update Usage_trend and Engagement_score weekly before standup.
- Put any open technical blockers into linked JIRA (tag: cs-renewal-sprint).
- SLA: if Priority_score > 85, engage Solutions Engineering and set 2-week acceleration path.

SAMPLE CHECKLIST BEFORE OUTREACH:
[ ] Confirm exec contact and cadence
[ ] Attach cost delta and adoption metrics
[ ] Prepare model/quantization recommendation if cost is concern
[ ] Propose clear next-step with date (calendar invite)

OPEN QUESTIONS / TO-FIX (notes-to-self):
- Need automated export from billing to populate ARR and Usage_trend (Finance + BI ticket).
- Add column for last_successful_delivery_date (feature launches tied to adoption).
- Validate ARR normalization formula with Rev Ops (is log10 heuristic OK?).

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- playbook repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/customer-playbooks
- sample canary runbook: Confluence link in linked_artifacts
- billing export prototype: JIRA-CS-478

---
Author notes (Maya): This sheet is intentionally opinionated and lightweight. Use as the single source for outreach prioritization during the renewal sprint. Expect iterative updates after first two sprints; capture what playbooks moved metrics and fold into standard templates.
